grandfather.name: Ernesto De Armas
grandfather.bio: A man of few words and great hands. Ernesto built the family home in 1952 and spent forty years tending the land he loved. His laughter filled every room.

grandmother.name: Jovita De Armas
grandmother.bio: Jovita kept the family together through every storm. Her kitchen was always open, her patience endless. She is remembered in every dish we make.

lourdes.name: Lourdes Torreon
lourdes.bio: Lourdes continues the family tradition with quiet strength and steady leadership.

dong.name: Fernando De Armas
dong.bio: Dong works behind the scenes to keep the family connected across generations.

marieta.name: Marietta Calayag
marieta.bio: Marietta is the family storyteller, keeping memories alive with every shared meal.

ronaldo.name: Ronaldo De Armas
ronaldo.bio: Ronaldo builds bridges between relatives with a generous heart and calm presence.

arnold.name: Arnold De Armas
arnold.bio: Arnold captures family life in vivid detail, preserving moments for years to come.

rebecca.name: Rebecca Artizuela
rebecca.bio: Rebecca is the family caretaker, always offering kindness and comfort where it is needed most.

ernestoParent.name: Ernesto De Armas Jr.
ernestoParent.bio: Ernesto carries the family name with pride and keeps the family history close.

jeffrey.name: Jeffrey Rynan De Armas
jeffrey.bio: Jeffrey uses creativity to bring family traditions into a fresh, modern life.

child1.name: Ana De Armas
child1.bio: Ana designs spaces where people feel at home. She says she learned that from watching her grandfather build.

child2.name: Pablo De Armas
child2.bio: Pablo turned his grandmother's recipes into a restaurant. Every table is a reunion.

child3.name: Sofía De Armas
child3.bio: Sofía believed in medicine before she believed in anything else. She is the family's quiet pillar.

child4.name: Miguel De Armas
child4.bio: Miguel documents what others overlook. He says a photograph is just a memory that doesn't fade.

grandchild1.name: Isabel De Armas
grandchild1.bio: The eldest of the new generation. Isabel already reads faster than anyone in the family.

grandchild2.name: Diego De Armas
grandchild2.bio: Diego wants to be an astronaut. The family has no reason to doubt him.
